answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each entrant to stake compute on a decentralized validation reef, where attestations accumulate like coral. Every interaction sends a distinct ripple across the peer graph, exposing clusters whose identical responses betray shared ancestry. Reputation climbs toward the summit of trust only through sustained, diverse proofs across epochs. Because constructing a synthetic reef demands prohibitive energy and any rogue ripple triggers automated slashing, running disposable clones becomes economically irrational.
